body_html:
JAMMIN’ DJs understands the importance of having high quality, reliable, and up to date equipment, so we spare no expense! We use the industry best when it comes to the gear we use at our performances. Some of these brands include JBL Pro, Shure Microphones, Chauvet Professional and DJ Intelligent Lighting, Pioneer DJ, Denon DJ and more!

JBL VRX 932

JBL PRX718 XLF



While intended for smaller venues than the VerTec series, the VRX Constant Curvature Line Array is designed and built to the same high standards and uses the same advanced, concert-proven drivers. The VRX delivers extraordinary power handling, clarity, flexibility and, of course, stunning JBL sound in an attractive, easy to handle and affordable package. The VRX is a perfect fit for medium-sized venues that don’t want to sacrifice sound quality just because they’re not as big as other professional facilities.

We pride ourselves on superior sound for our event which is why we spare no expense in our speakers, we have out JBL PRX 615 which has a higher grade 15″ sub woofer with a max of 1000 watts per speaker.

With ZLX, Electro-Voice set out with a singular goal: to deliver best-in-class performance across every detail. ZLX combines decades of proven pro-audio engineering know-how with a bold new look and user-friendly features that give you an extraordinary amount of control over your sound – all with the renowned EV quality and reliability the pros trust.

1500W Powered PA Subwoofer with 18″ Differential Drive low-frequency driver.The JBL PRX718XLF Powered PA Subwoofer delivers your bass with accuracy and power.

Dual 10-inch Powered Line Array Loudspeaker

The SRX900 Series represents JBL’s cutting-edge performance principles in audio technology. This new generation of powered line arrays and subwoofers meets the increasing demand for scalable small and medium-format professional sound reinforcement solutions. Ideal for rental companies, fixed installations, and musicians, it offers an exceptional blend of performance and portability.

BassBoss DV12-MK3

The DV12-MK3 is the ultimate portable powerhouse on a pole. Its wide horizontal coverage and precise vertical coverage ensure that sound is perfectly focused on the audience in most event spaces. These are typically level-floor venues where the audience is spread out, covering around 90% of all events.

BassBoss SSP118-MK3

The SSP118-MK3 is packed with features, and the more you use it, the more you’ll appreciate its design. Built to professional standards, it is exceptionally durable, resembling a bunker in sturdiness. The SSP118-MK3 includes carts for easy transport, truck-pack-friendly dimensions, interlocking feet for stacking, and ergonomic handles and hand-holds on all four sides.

Portable System/Ceremony System

If you are looking for a portable smaller ceremony or cocktail hour option, we utilize the Fender Passport venue system, and the EV Evolve 50.

EV Evolve 50

The black Electro-Voice EVOLVE 50 Portable 1000W Bluetooth-Enabled Subwoofer is part of the EVOLVE 50 portable PA system, which consists of a powered subwoofer, magnetic speaker pole, and a column array full-range speaker. The powered subwoofer utilizes a 12″ driver and is powered by the integrated 1000W (500W to subwoofer) amplifier.

Low lying fog option with the Chauvet Nimbus


Our systems also consist of wireless microphones for more crowd interaction.
We love wireless! We use Shure branded wireless microphones, and Shure Accessories! The Shure ULX Professional Series wireless microphone systems provide professional wireless microphone solutions for broadcast, performances, professional mobile entertainment events, conferences, schools, and businesses. The system includes the ULXP4 diversity receiver, ULX1 body-pack transmitter and WL185 lavalier microphone.

*Wireless Microphones may be subject to interference depending on other frequency use in the area such as tv/radio antennas, cell phone use etc. JAMMIN’ DJs cannot be held liable for any interruption in signal or interference.

The Shure ULX Professional Series wireless microphone systems provide professional wireless microphone solutions for broadcast, performances, professional mobile entertainment events, conferences, schools, and businesses. COLD SPARKS

Give your wedding an experience like no other with our cold spark effect. Safe to the touch but exciting as the real thing. We can also control it and time it with the music with different effects like the video above. You can just hear and see the excitement from your guests with this effect.

 

WHY CHOOSE US?

  • We use cold spark machines which are manufactured by Sparktacular FX who are the inventors of the cold spark technology and have 25 years of experience in pyrotechnics. They are the originators and not knock-offs.
  • We can choreograph it to your music. Currently we are the only company in Hawaii to provide this “Disney Water Fountain” effect.
  • We have trained and certified staff to set up and operate the machines.
  • The machines we use are currently the best top of the line machines out there. These are the same machines that are used in Super Bowls and Las Vegas nightclubs. They are not China knock-offs which are unreliable and a risk to operate.
